purpose: silver_nyc_weather is the cleaned hourly weather observation table for the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) over the first half of 2013, derived from bronze.nyc_weather. It carries one row per airport per observation hour with typed numeric measures and a true timestamp, and it feeds flight-delay and operations analytics that join weather conditions to departure times.
usage: Join on origin plus time_hour to flight data; time_hour is a UTC timestamp and year, month, day and hour are integer components of the same observation, so use either the timestamp or the parts but not both as independent keys. wind_gust, pressure, wind_dir and wind_speed are nullable and consumers must decide deliberately how to handle missing readings rather than assuming zero. Treat extreme wind_speed values (observed max 1048.36058) as suspect and filter them explicitly if the analysis is sensitive to outliers.
limitations: Coverage is partial: month holds only the 6 distinct values 1.0 through 6.0 and year is a single value 2013, so this is a half-year extract, not a full year. wind_gust is sparsely populated at a null_rate of 0.745505 and pressure at 0.114953, so aggregates over those measures cover a subset of hours. Unit semantics are not stated by the profile and the apparent wind_speed outlier at 1048.36058 was retained unaltered; the declared grain of origin plus time_hour is inferred from distinct_count 4341 for time_hour against row_count 13014 and must be measured against the warehouse before approval.
